'''Dirlid Bond''' was the director for the [[Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children]],<ref name="Mail" /> an orphanage located on the [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] of [[Mek-Sha]],<ref name="A Dash of Kindness">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|A Dash of Kindness|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Mail" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> Bond oversaw the donations made to the orphanage by the [[Alliance Commander]] and sent a message to the Commander expressing gratitude for the Commander's contributions and generosity.<ref name="Mail" />
